name: redline
description: A row above the prompt that appears only when something is red: a failing check on this branch's PR, or your own health command

watchCi.title: Watch this branch's PR checks
watchCi.description: Show the row when `gh pr checks` reports a failure on the current branch's pull request. Needs the gh CLI; silent without it or without a PR.

healthCommand.title: Health command (JSON argv)
healthCommand.description: A command to run on a timer, as a JSON array, e.g. ["my-status", "--short"]. Empty means no health check. Red when it exits non-zero, or, with a pattern below, when its output does not match.

healthOkPattern.title: Health OK pattern (regex)
healthOkPattern.description: A regular expression that the command's output matches while everything is fine. With it, a command that fails to run stays silent instead of showing red. Empty means judge by the exit code.

healthLabel.title: Health label
healthLabel.description: Word that starts the health part of the row.

everySeconds.title: Check every (seconds)
everySeconds.description: How often both checks run. At least 30.
